pages.title: DON'T PANIC DUDE!
pages.creator: RYOAN Games
pages.description: Jump over spikes in DON'T PANIC DUDE! while DUDE, the AI running the simulation, comments on your attempts. The course keeps going and speeds up the longer you survive, leaving less time to react to each hazard. Play for a longer run and unlock different heroes along the way.

pages.title: Jungle Solitaire
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Build descending runs from king to ace in Jungle Solitaire. Moving a card for the first time earns a diamond, but a move that earns none costs points. Deal a fresh row when you run out of useful moves and see whether you can clear the cards before time expires.

pages.title: Sky Assault
pages.creator: S.Studio
pages.description: Drop from a helicopter onto a neon skyscraper in Sky Assault and fight down through procedurally generated floors. Stand on a crate to open it and look for weapons or ammo. Clear the enemies to unlock the exit and face bosses as you descend deeper into the tower.

pages.title: Reflect Beam: Laser Logic
pages.creator: Asmodeus
pages.description: Guide a laser to its destination in Reflect Beam: Laser Logic. Rotate pieces to send it through a narrow tunnel, draw a route through a maze, or clear blocks and obstacles that interrupt the beam. Each mode changes how you can open a path, and one makes you solve the puzzle against the clock.

pages.title: Quiz 10 Seconds Math
pages.creator: Maurus
pages.description: Quiz 10 Seconds Math gives you ten seconds to answer each arithmetic question. Switch between addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division as the problems get harder. Work quickly enough to beat the clock while keeping your answers accurate, then see whether you can improve your best score.

pages.title: God's Mixer
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description: Build a fighter in God's Mixer by choosing a head, body, and weapon. Try combinations that would never normally go together, then send the creations into battle against each other. Change parts between fights to see how a different build fares.

pages.title: Candy Smash
pages.creator: Digital Will Inc.
pages.description: Tap groups of candy to clear them from the board in Candy Smash. Look at where each cluster sits and decide which one to remove first so you can set up another clear. Keep building your score while you still have lives left.

pages.title: Puzzle Blocks Asmr Match
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Place pieces into a block puzzle where gravity can change the layout in Puzzle Blocks Asmr Match. When lower blocks disappear, the ones above fall into the space they leave. You cannot rotate the incoming shapes, so look for a gap that fits and think about what might shift when you clear it.

pages.title: Block Mine Fuse TNT
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Demolish Herobrine's blocky settlements in Block Mine Fuse TNT. Drop explosives onto the buildings and use rockets when you want to attack them another way. Upgrade your arsenal as you go and see what it takes to knock down the next structure.

pages.title: Gladiator Fights
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fight as a gladiator in ancient Rome in Gladiator Fights. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and choose between quick strikes, stronger attacks, and kicks. Face a series of opponents and watch their attacks before you close the distance.

pages.title: Day of Atrocity
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Hold back a growing swarm in Day of Atrocity. Enemies keep spawning across the voxel map, and they arrive faster as the fight goes on. Move to where the crowd is building and clear it before the enemies can overrun the whole area.

pages.title: Sort Resort
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Pour liquids between flasks in Sort Resort and separate the colors. Look at which color is on top before choosing where to pour next. The sorting puzzles are paired with a drawing activity, so you also reveal a picture as you work through the level.

pages.title: Piggy Clicker
pages.creator: Manvel Azarjan
pages.description: Tap your pet pig to earn pennies in Piggy Clicker. Save up for toys and other items, then buy them from the menu when you can afford them. Keep tapping Piggy as you build up the money for your next purchase.

pages.title: Thor Merge
pages.creator: PT Arena Solusi Digital
pages.description: Merge worlds from the Nine Realms in Thor Merge. Bring matching planets together to create a larger one and watch how the new world fits among the others. Aim for a personal best in solo play or compete against other players in PvP.

pages.title: Crazy Alien Adventure
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Run, jump, and dash through Crazy Alien Adventure to rescue animals from cages. Use the rush move to smash the wooden stakes holding them in, and collect stars and power-ups along the route. Spend stars on items or outfits as you try to reach more animals.

pages.title: Clownfish Pin Out
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Get water to the stranded fish in Clownfish Pin Out. Pull the pins in an order that lets the water reach the fish without letting lava through. Study which chambers each pin separates before opening a route.

pages.title: 2-3-4 Player Games
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Pick from 21 mini-games in 2-3-4 Player Games and play with up to three friends. The objective changes depending on what you choose. Some games are about scoring more than your opponents, while others are races to the finish.

pages.title: Clean The Ocean
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Take a boat out to collect waste and clear oil spills in Clean The Ocean. Bring the rubbish back and sort it for recycling before heading out again. Upgrade your boat as you work through more of the sea.

pages.title: Frosty Connection Quest
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find pairs of matching winter tiles in Frosty Connection Quest. You can remove two identical pictures when the path between them takes at most two turns. Each clear can open up a route to other tiles, so keep checking the gaps as the board changes.

pages.title: 4x4 Offroader
pages.creator: Faramel Games
pages.description: Take an off-road vehicle out on the tracks in 4x4 Offroader. Choose from the available cars and test how they handle ramps and rough terrain. Try a different route or vehicle when you want to practice controlling your approach and landing.

pages.title: Mini Kart Rush
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Race karts on 3D platform tracks in Mini Kart Rush. You need to finish ahead of at least half the field to move on. Bumping rivals can help you gain speed, so use the space on the track to decide when to hit another kart and when to steer past it.

pages.title: Hammer Hit
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Throw a hammer at enemies in Hammer Hit. Aim directly when you have a clear shot, or bounce the hammer off a friendly warrior's shield to reach a target at an angle. Work out how to use the shields in each of the 50 layouts.

pages.title: Alien Reform
pages.description: Fight increasingly strong aliens in Alien Reform, a 3D survival shooter. Clear stages and defeat the boss guarding the move to the next map. Spend in-game currency on weapons and upgrades, including a bazooka, and earn experience that counts toward the daily rankings.

pages.title: Huggy Army Commander
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build a force in Huggy Army Commander by collecting military cards. Use them to assemble soldiers and unlock more camps, then start the fight once the troops are ready. Keep building up the army so you have more to work with in later battles.

pages.title: Sumo.io
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Push rivals out of the arena in Sumo.io and try to be the last one inside. Watch your position near the edge before going for a shove, since another player can push you out too. Improve your character with gear and try different arenas and skins as you play.

pages.title: Slashville3D
pages.creator: Udo Games Oyun Yazilim Anonim Sirketi
pages.description: Harvest tomatoes with your blade in Slashville3D. Collect what you cut and use it as you build up your town. Upgrade your character for adventures beyond the farm, fight enemies along the way, and buy pets as you develop the settlement.

pages.title: Ice And Fire Twins
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Fight opponents with elemental powers in Ice And Fire Twins. Use ice and fire as you shoot through the enemies in your path. Pay attention to where targets appear so you can aim the next attack before they overwhelm your position.

pages.title: Tank Duel 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Challenge a friend or the computer in Tank Duel 3D. Steer through arenas with different layouts and traps while looking for a shot at the other tank. Pick up bonuses when you have a safe route to them and use the map to plan your next move.

pages.title: Lucky Fisherman
pages.creator: funky forest
pages.description: Cast your line for fish in Lucky Fisherman. Look at what is swimming below before dropping the hook, then try to bring in a larger catch on the next cast. Work through the fishing spots and get used to judging when a fish is within reach.

pages.title: Golf
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Sink the ball in at most five shots in Golf. Aim and set up each stroke in a side-view course, then check where the ball stops before taking another shot. Leave yourself a useful angle for the next stroke if you cannot reach the hole in one.

pages.title: Orbits
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Move a yellow ball between circular tracks in Orbits. Wait for a gap in the other balls before switching circles so you can reach the ring without crashing. A new ring appears after each pickup, giving you another route to plan as your score climbs.

pages.title: Detective Loupe Puzzle
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Investigate cases in Detective Loupe Puzzle. Search scenes for hidden objects, spot differences, and use what you find to answer questions about suspects or strange events. One puzzle might ask you to identify a vampire, while another asks you to work out who committed a murder.

pages.title: Crazy Juice Fruit Master
pages.creator: Game Ashlar
pages.description: Time your throws to slice fruit in Crazy Juice Fruit Master. Hit several pieces with one throw for a bonus, and finish levels to collect cocktails. Four cocktails earn a spin of the fortune wheel, with rarer drinks bringing better rewards.

pages.title: Post Pandemic Fashion Outfits
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style outfits with face masks in Post Pandemic Fashion Outfits. A fashion adviser gives you a look to reproduce for each event. Use the clothes and accessories to match the example, then choose a mask that fits the rest of the outfit.

pages.title: Paper Flight 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Launch a paper plane in Paper Flight 2 and try to send it farther on each attempt. Use the rewards from earlier flights to improve characteristics such as speed or strength. Make another launch after an upgrade to see what difference it makes to the distance.

pages.title: Halloween Puzzle Game
pages.creator: Multoigri
pages.description: Choose from twelve spooky pictures in Halloween Puzzle Game and put the pieces back together. Pick one of four difficulty settings before you start. Work at a pace that suits the board, or try to finish quickly to earn more points.

pages.title: Mummy Candies
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Help the mummy collect sweets in Mummy Candies. Aim for candies and lollipops while steering clear of explosive pumpkins that can spoil a pickup. Visit the store between attempts to improve what the mummy can do, then try to bring back more sweets.

pages.title: Popsy Princess Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Put pictures of the Popsy Princess characters back together in Popsy Princess Jigsaw Puzzle. Move each piece into place and check how its outline and colors meet the next piece. Start with a detail you recognize, then use it to build up the rest of the scene.

pages.title: Mermaids Puzzle
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of mermaids from different seas in Mermaids Puzzle. The game has twelve mermaids to discover as you put the images together. Look for parts of a tail, hair, or the background to see which pieces connect.

pages.title: Super MX The Champion
pages.creator: Barnzmu
pages.description: Ride a dirt bike in Super MX The Champion. Enter Racing to compete on the course or switch to Free Ride to get used to the bike without a race. Use WASD or the arrow keys and watch how the bike handles each approach.

pages.title: Halloween Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Fire bubbles at the board in Halloween Bubble Shooter. Aim for a group that matches the color of the bubble in the launcher so the pieces can pop. Check where you have a clear shot and work through the Halloween-themed arrangement.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Play as X in Tic Tac Toe Mania on a three-by-three or five-by-five board. Make a line across, down, or diagonally before O does. The smaller board takes three marks in a row, and the larger one takes four. Play on your own or with a friend.

pages.title: Extreme Car Driving Simulator
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Use the arrow keys to drive a drift car in Extreme Car Driving Simulator. Build up speed, then use the steering and brakes to carry a slide through a turn. The challenge is to keep control of the car as it moves sideways in the 3D environment.

pages.title: Lucky Looter
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Steal treasure without being seen in Lucky Looter. Slide to move and watch the guards' fields of view before heading in. Wait for a patrol to look elsewhere before you cross an exposed area, and plan the way out as carefully as the way in.

pages.title: Strawberry Shortcake Sweet Shop
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Make desserts for Strawberry Shortcake and her friends in Strawberry Shortcake Sweet Shop. Pick a sweet recipe and work through the kitchen steps to put it together. See how the ingredients become a finished treat for the guests to try.

pages.title: Dump Trucks Hidden Objects
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Find ten hidden wheelbarrows in each picture in Dump Trucks Hidden Objects. Search the areas around the trucks and check details that blend into the scene. Keep an eye on the time so you can find the last wheelbarrow before the round ends.

pages.title: Apple Dumplings
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Bake a dessert with green apples and cinnamon in Apple Dumplings. Follow the prompts through the recipe a step at a time. The dish pairs the warm apple filling with ice cream, so watch how the preparation comes together before serving.

pages.title: Helix Descend
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Guide a bouncing ball down a tower in Helix Descend. Turn the stack so the ball reaches gaps between the platforms and drops farther. Watch the platforms below as you move, since each opening sets up the next part of the descent.

pages.title: Frankenstein Adventures
pages.creator: GameNing
pages.description: Jump past obstacles in Frankenstein Adventures. Click or tap to time a leap and collect stars when you can reach them safely. Twelve levels give you different hazards to read, so look at where the character will land before you make the next jump.

pages.title: Run Life Simulator
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Guide a girl through a course based on stages of her life in Run Life Simulator. Hold and slide to move her around the obstacles. Keep looking ahead so you can steer through each stretch as the game moves from one part of her life to the next.

pages.title: Snake Worm
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Steer a worm toward dots in Snake Worm. Keep away from the other worms, since a collision ends your run. Use a burst of speed when you need to escape or reach a group of dots, and watch your energy so you still have some when you need it.

pages.title: Police Truck Driver Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive a police monster truck through a city in Police Truck Driver Simulator. Take a run at tall ramps to make jumps, or cruise the streets in another police vehicle with oversized tires. Steer with WASD and use Space for the handbrake.

pages.title: Car vs Zombie Derby
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive into the undead in Car vs Zombie Derby. Use the handbrake to turn the car and nitro to build speed when you need to hit another group. Work through the levels, upgrade your vehicle, and try different cars against the zombies.

pages.title: My Dolphin Show 1 HTML5
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Perform for the crowd in My Dolphin Show 1 HTML5. Use the arrow keys to move the dolphin and follow the trainer's instructions for the next stunt. Time your flips and jumps as the show moves from one trick to the next.

pages.title: Jelly Smash
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Set off a chain reaction in Jelly Smash. Use the blue jelly to make a splash that reaches other jellies. Look at the gaps between them before starting, since a well-placed burst can send droplets onward and clear more of the board.

pages.title: Owl Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Turn over tiles to find matching owls in Owl Memory. Remember which owl appeared in each position so you can make a pair when you see it again. There are four levels, and you can challenge yourself to clear a board in fewer turns.

pages.title: Car Drifting Xtreme
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Take a performance car onto drift tracks in Car Drifting Xtreme. Set up a slide as you enter a bend and use the drift helper to keep the car moving through it. Try different cars, including turbo and naturally aspirated options, to see how they handle the track.

pages.title: Billiards 8 Ball
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Line up cue shots in Billiards 8 Ball. Play a timed round when you want to see how quickly you can pot the balls, or challenge another player. Watch where the cue ball will end up after a shot so you can plan the next one.

pages.title: Touch The Wall
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Move toward the finish in Touch The Wall and stop when the count reaches the signal. Use the moments when you can move to get around obstacles and make progress toward the wall. Pay attention to the count before taking another step.

pages.title: 2019 Mother's Day Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Compare two pictures in 2019 Mother's Day Differences. Click the details that change between the scenes before time expires, and try to finish quickly for a better score. Use the hint button when you are stuck on a difference you cannot find.

pages.title: Road Fury
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Drive along the highway and shoot at other vehicles in Road Fury. Enemy cars behave differently and drop different pickups, so watch what comes at you and steer around traffic as you fire. Collect power-ups during the run and spend cash on upgrades.

pages.title: Woodventure
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Clear a forest-themed Mahjong board in Woodventure. Link identical tiles along a path with no more than two turns. A hint can show a match, a bomb can remove a random pair, and a reshuffle can change the whole board when you run out of ideas.

pages.title: Rummy Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Choose an online match, a computer opponent, or a friend on the same device in Rummy Multiplayer. Draw and discard as you work toward sets and runs. Check what the other player picks up before you decide which card to leave in the discard pile.

pages.title: Classic Solitaire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Build four suit piles from ace to king in Classic Solitaire. On the main board, arrange cards in descending order and alternate red and black to uncover the face-down cards. Use the tutorial to learn the layout or undo a move when you want to try another sequence.

pages.title: Slicing Game
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Swipe through balls as they fly across the screen in Slicing Game. Watch for launches from below and from the sides so you can catch several balls with a single swipe. Try the two modes, including Chill, and keep an eye out for bombs.

pages.title: Ear Doctor
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Treat patients in Ear Doctor. Check what needs attention and use the appropriate instrument as you work through the ear treatment. Follow the steps in order so you can deal with each problem before the appointment ends.

pages.title: Christmas Five Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Look for five changes between Christmas pictures in Christmas Five Differences. Compare the same area in both scenes before clicking, since small details can be easy to overlook. Find every difference to clear the picture.

pages.title: EG Baller IO
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Roll around the arena collecting objects in EG Baller IO. The size of your ball determines what it can pick up. Keep gathering what fits while steering away from computer-controlled rivals, and see how high a score you can earn before time runs out.

pages.title: Armored Blasters I
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drive a tank through overhead battles in Armored Blasters I. Aim at enemy tanks as you move around the battlefield and use different weapons to blast a path through the fight. Keep track of threats from other directions while you line up a shot.

pages.title: WorldCraft 2
pages.creator: AngryGamez
pages.description: Build with cubes in WorldCraft 2. Explore the game's worlds, then put blocks together to make a house, a garden, or a city of your own. Share the building and exploration with friends if you want to take on a larger project together.

pages.title: Mermaid Mix n' Match
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Create a mermaid in Mermaid Mix n' Match. Try different ways to customize her appearance and combine features with pieces from her wardrobe. See how changing one part of the design affects the whole character before you settle on a finished look.

pages.title: Lucky Tiles
pages.creator: Duchnowski
pages.description: Tap groups of three or more matching tiles in Lucky Tiles. Clearing a group changes the board, so look for the next color cluster while the timer is running. Pick up bonuses as they appear and try to reach a higher score before time runs out.

pages.title: PuzzleGuys Hearts
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Play Hearts against three computer opponents in PuzzleGuys Hearts. Follow the suit led when you can and try to avoid taking tricks that contain hearts or the queen of spades. Watch which cards have already been played before deciding what to lead or discard.

pages.title: Couple Movie Night
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get Anna and Elsa ready for a trip to the cinema in Couple Movie Night. Choose Anna's outfit first, then help Elsa find a look for the same outing. Try different pieces on each princess to see what suits her plans for the evening.

pages.title: Sweety Mahjong
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Find matching sweets in Sweety Mahjong and remove the pairs from the layout. Look for tiles that are free to pick before choosing a match. Each pair you clear can open up more of the board and give you access to the tiles beneath it.

pages.title: Doll House Cake Cooking
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Bake a cake shaped like a dollhouse in Doll House Cake Cooking. Start by heating the butter, then follow the recipe to make the cake from scratch. Once the baking is done, use the decorations to finish the house-shaped dessert.

pages.title: Kingdom Creator
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Build the look of a fairy-tale kingdom in Kingdom Creator. Select the part of the scene you want to change and try its available designs. Combine your choices across the landscape until the whole kingdom looks the way you want.

pages.title: Modern HighSchool Looks
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get Elsa and Jack Frost ready for school in Modern HighSchool Looks. Pick a style for each character before their special day, then see how the two outfits look together. Try a different combination if you want to give either character a different school-day look.

pages.title: Dove Wedding Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Open mystery boxes to find bridal pieces in Dove Wedding Dolly Dress Up H5. Build an outfit for Dove, then check its rating in the gallery. Work through the styling tasks and achievements and try new combinations as you aim for a five-star wedding look.
